Pinging @maestromac and @Zhao-Andy — one of these two fine folks will jump in with a response to help you out here.

Hey @markfrst, do you have your own Algolia API keys? If not, you'll need to get that first -- [instructions here.](https://docs.dev.to/get-api-keys-dev-env/)

If you do have them, you might need to index your articles:
```ruby
Article.reindex
```

Let me know how that goes!

@Zhao-Andy yes, i did set all api keys

Thanks, i will try it

@markfrst You might also need to destroy all your reading list reactions via Rails console, and then try (via clicking the button) to add them again.
```ruby
Reaction.where(category: 'readinglist').destroy_all
```
@Zhao-Andy maybe make non-fixed sidebar on the reading page as on home page?

@markfrst Hmm, not sure what you mean; are you thinking the home page sidebar should also be in the reading list page? Or are you talking about making the current existing footer a right-side sidebar in the reading list page?

I think the simplest solution would be to move the footer down a bit on that page specifically, when there are no reading list items saved. @benhalpern might have some additional thoughts.
